title: Artinianity and flatness of the explicit transcendental image
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $B$ an Artinian local commutative $k$-algebra. Let $A_0\subseteq B$ be a local admissible subalgebra [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] relative to $\mathfrak m_B$, with local inclusion. Give $K=B/\mathfrak m_B$ the structure of an $F_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_{A_0}$-algebra compatible with the $k$-scalar tower and with residues of every element of $A_0$. Let $x\in B$ have transcendental residue over $F_0$ [def-weil-algebraic-element]. For the explicit image $A$ [def-weil-pbc-popescu-localized-polynomial-image], $A$ is Artinian, its inclusion into $B$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $\mathfrak m_A B=\mathfrak m_B$.

source.place: Tag 07FI, transcendental case: localization of the polynomial evaluation map and its image; admissibility from Tag 07FH. Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FI and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH.

proof.text: Reduction of θ factors as the residue coefficient map followed by evaluation at α. Transcendence makes the latter injective. The polynomial coefficient-map kernel is m₀[T], so P=m₀[T]. The Noetherian localization D=A₀[T]_P has maximal ideal m₀D; this ideal is nilpotent. The Artinian iff nilpotent maximal ideal criterion in Mathlib gives Artinianity of D. Its image A is a quotient of D, hence Artinian. Surjectivity D→A and ideal-map composition give m_A B=m₀B=m_B.

Every homomorphism from an Artinian local ring to a nontrivial ring reflects units: a nonunit in the source is nilpotent, so cannot have unit image. Thus A₀→D and D→B are local. The quotient D/m₀D is a field because m₀D=m_D. Its tensor fibre with B is a vector space, therefore free and flat. Admissibility gives flatness of B over A₀; apply the Noetherian fibre criterion with R=A₀, S=D, S′=M=B to prove flatness of B over D.

The local flat evaluation map D→B is faithfully flat. Mathlib gives faithful scalar action, hence injectivity of its algebra map. The range restriction D→A is now bijective. Its inverse is flat; composing that inverse with D→B proves flatness of A→B.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_transcendental_image_structure
    (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (A₀ : Subalgebra k B) [IsLocalRing A₀]
    (hA₀ : A₀.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
    (x : B) [IsLocalHom A₀.val]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    [IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (hmap : ∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
        IsLocalRing.residue B (a₀ : B))
    (hα : Transcendental (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.residue B x)) :
    IsArtinianRing (popescuLocalizedPolynomialImage A₀ x) ∧
      (popescuLocalizedPolynomialImage A₀ x).val.toRingHom.Flat ∧
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (popescuLocalizedPolynomialImage A₀ x)).map
        (popescuLocalizedPolynomialImage A₀ x).val.toRingHom =
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
